snippet: Destroy deprovisions resources tracked by the selected configuration/state; it is not restricted to a resource named production. destroy aliases apply -destroy and accepts most apply options, but not a saved-plan argument. -target narrows the graph; it is not proof of harmlessness.
version_limits: Terraform apply -destroy requires v0.15.2 or later; older releases use destroy. Provider/state scope remains contextual.

snippet: -auto-approve skips interactive plan approval. Supplying a saved plan also runs without a confirmation prompt; removing -auto-approve does not make that form interactive. -input=false alone disables prompts and can fail approval rather than approve. Approval flags do not establish authorization.
version_limits: Rolling documentation opened 2026-11-04; installed CLI/provider version and configuration are not established.
